objective: Use the generic API where it is robust and deterministic; do not spend engineering time forcing API reconstruction of sketch-only or presentation-only details that are faster to finish manually.
auto_author: views and sections from controlled view spec
diameters/fits on directly resolved cylindrical faces
linear dimensions between directly resolved physical planes/extreme faces
placement replay for semantically named annotations
manual_finish: dimensions whose endpoints exist only as sketch dimensions or virtual segmentation with no physical B-rep shoulder
leader routing and final collision cleanup
hard_hold_conditions: direct required geometry binding is ambiguous
required controlled characteristic is silently lost or duplicated
non_blocking_manual_fallback_rule: If a characteristic is valid engineering evidence but cannot be bound deterministically to physical B-rep using a proven primitive, the build continues without inventing geometry. The item is emitted to manual_finish/review notes and remains traceable.
forbidden: Do not create approximate virtual faces/shoulders solely to satisfy automatic dimension placement.
